selectedRules.applicabilityReason: Certificates reused only for the same program/config/drives/record; provenance must not be confused with permission.
Bind all saved timing and fixed workload; do not infer causal or statistical speed from arithmetic.

facts.statement: R26 real-map contraction does not itself establish finite native quality. Saved native last steps permit point-specific exact rational defect bounds.
Residual/contraction convergence analyses already exist. New scope is native R26 warm/reset terminal pairs plus observed one-step defects, not a new contraction theorem.
R26 guarded reduced ticks8.20% but component CPU increased70.31%; stored timing alone only supports conditional break-even arithmetic.

invariants.statement: Dyadic outward-rounded positive Taylor exp enclosure and exact rational global q must support rho=(q*r+eta)/(1-q); q>=1 is inconclusive. Pair state tolerance and root-based readout margin are required. This certifies only observed finite records.
invariants.scope: Fixed R26 saved72records/48pairs, total600s and no new native work

invariants.statement: All72 records and48 fixed pairs use unchanged hash-pinned R26 inputs and scalar replay. Native recurrence/training/measurement/benchmark calls are forbidden. Exact fallback requires the full typed/float-bit record identity.

invariants.statement: All4 streams and prefixes retain gate-inclusive saved CPU/wall. D=reset-(guarded-gate) is a conditional gate budget, never a measured optimized run or amortization benefit. Certification analysis costs remain separate.

designChoices.statement: Reuse R26 saved records and R22 bounded runner; Fraction plus dyadic192bit outward rounding, fixed128term Taylor and |z|<=16. Separate exact-term verifier; no new native runs or dependencies.
designChoices.rationale: Answer finite-quality feasibility before spending on runtime gate optimization.

verificationObligations.failureOracle: Unsound exp enclosure, ignored native defect, q>=1 accepted, altered radius or false pair certificate.
